classifications.READY: Data confirmed reachable and sufficient today.

top5.notes: Overnight return = today's open / yesterday's close - 1; intraday return = today's close / today's open - 1. Both fields already exist in every OHLC bar this project already fetches — no new data source needed at all.

top5.notes: Two viable, Alpaca-native execution paths: (a) exchange-traded short-vol/long-vol ETPs (e.g., SVXY/VXX) traded as ordinary equities, or (b) SPY options spreads via Alpaca's multi-leg options support. Both are READY without a new broker. A raw options-chain history for backtesting will need Alpaca's Options Data API or a vendor snapshot — flagged PARTIAL only for the historical-backtest-quality options chain, not for live/paper execution.

Expanding to a broader stock universe (for a 'real' cross-sectional low-vol strategy rather than a 4-ETF proxy) would need a wider point-in-time price history — not required for this round's pre-registered design (§ below), which stays within the existing universe.

notableExclusionsForReference.reason: Requires a point-in-time consensus-estimate/earnings-surprise history across a broad stock universe to avoid look-ahead. No free, reliable, point-in-time source was found (Yahoo's current-day earnings data is not vintage-safe; SEC EDGAR provides raw filings but not analyst consensus). This is the same class of limitation Block 8.2 already documented for Family 2 (Economic Momentum FX) and resolved the same way: DATA_INSUFFICIENT, not fabricated.

Advance/decline and %-above-moving-average series for the full NYSE/Nasdaq universe are typically index-provider proprietary (S&P, Nasdaq) or paywalled (Barchart, WSJ Market Data). A narrower proxy (e.g., breadth across only this project's own 4-ETF universe) is technically READY but would not be a faithful test of the published research, which uses full-market breadth.

FRED provides Treasury yields, credit spreads (BAA10Y, etc.), and USD indices free and keyless — the same source class already used in Block 8.2 for carry/value construction. Feasible if scoped to 1-2 signals; not pursued this round per the many-variable-model warning in §7.E.

Alpaca does not offer futures trading. A futures-capable broker (e.g., a CME FCM) would be required — documented per §7.H's explicit instruction not to discard the idea outright, but not implementable without new broker infrastructure this block does not build.
